name: JDownloader
author: JohnAndrewsX
description: JDownloader in the Omarchy bar: bring the window back or tuck it away, send links via Click'n'Load, keep an eye on finished downloads — no cloud, no account, no deprecated API.

barWidget.description: The tray icon JDownloader cannot have under Wayland: show/hide the window, send a link from the clipboard, see finished downloads, set font size and smoothing. English and German.

schema.label: Language
schema.description: auto follows the session locale (LANGUAGE, LC_MESSAGES, LANG); English is the fallback.

schema.label: Right-click on a visible window
schema.description: hide tucks the window into a special workspace, focus only brings it to the front.

schema.label: Finished downloads shown in the panel
